code_findings.evidence: All eight packet record hashes differ from corresponding call hashes; each validates independently under its convention.
code_findings.fix: Use digest(prompt.encode()) for raw artifact identity or explicitly name and retain both hash conventions. Do not rewrite historical records.
code_findings.issue: prompt_sha256 hashes canonical JSON string while invocation receipts hash raw file bytes

code_findings.evidence: A function row with disposition=token_limit, review_score=None, proposal=lower_priority passes prepare and yields an empty candidate declarations list. Current real predictions do not demonstrate this inconsistency.
code_findings.fix: Require validated predicted disposition, finite in-range score and consistent frozen threshold before omission; otherwise retain or reject.

code_findings.evidence: Collector stores actual path bytes in non_utf8_paths_base64 but prepare passes [non-UTF-8 path: ...] to git diff. Actual raw path is never reconstructed, so fallback can silently be empty. Not exercised by this cohort.
code_findings.fix: Decode lossless recorded path bytes and use literal pathspecs; if evidence cannot be represented, record unavailable evidence instead of an apparently complete empty diff.
code_findings.issue: Non-UTF-8 path fallback uses display placeholder as Git path

limitations: Existing open PRs predate registration; operational shadow, not a prospective PR cohort.
31 of32 nominally omitted functions remain in shared full-file diffs. Only PR357 function:*table.close loses changed-code evidence. Most savings are duplicate removal.
Both full and candidate arms contain partial declaration diffs, not complete function bodies or dependency context. Full-arm Open false positive demonstrates this limitation.

Paired preparer does not enforce collector120000-byte review-packet bound: PR399 had packet_byte_limit but paired full prompt is351345 bytes; PR357 full is137046 bytes. This new unbounded packet policy must be stated or bounded explicitly.
Only one stochastic review per arm per PR; differences in findings do not establish defect recall. PR360 identical prompts produce differing text, demonstrating sampling variation.
Use ordinary+cache-creation+cache-read tokens as total input. Reported cost includes unequal cache creation/read effects and output reasoning; PR360 identical inputs have unequal costs.
Model alias opus is not a version pin; preserve actual returned model identity for each call.
No inference of human quality parity, confirmed defect recall, or general production cost savings from four PRs.
Source adjudication is static inspection, not exploit/concurrency reproduction. Unknown conditions remain explicit.
